description: Similar companies for each seed domain: same industry, same country and similar headcount by default, each with name, domain, LinkedIn page, industry, headcount, HQ, founding year, last funding round and an explicit matchedOn string. Use to expand best customers into target accounts. $0.0015 per company delivered; the seed, duplicates and unresolved seeds are free. Not for company search by filters without a seed.

countries.description: Look in these countries instead of the seed country

maxChargeUsd.description: Maximum spend for this call in USD (default 5); the run stops at the cap and rows already delivered are the only ones charged

maxPerSeed.description: Lookalikes per seed (default 25); the spend cap

sameCountry.description: Lookalikes headquartered in the seed country (default true)

sameSize.description: Between half and twice the seed headcount (default true)

seedDomains.description: Example companies, as website domains (acme.com); full URLs are reduced to the domain

name: find_lookalike_companies
